snippet.title: Sonic Mania Plus | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Run, jump and collect gold rings as Sonic, Tails or Knuckles in this speedy homage made by and for fans of the beloved franchise. '90s nostalgia awaits!

Play Sonic Mania Plus on your mobile devices. Available exclusively on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/game/81679785

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services with over 247 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
